tips_en: Start with the RIDE paper (Paper 2) on RL-induced direction extrapolation, as it offers the deepest theoretical grounding—linking representation-level distillation, extrapolation theory, and a mechanistic analysis of the LM head's anisotropy—with the cleanest and most rigorously controlled experiments. The UniEvo-VL paper (Paper 1) is a natural second read: both papers share the on-policy self-distillation paradigm, but Paper 1 extends the idea from text reasoning into flow-based image generation via critique-conditioned privileged prompts. Finally, the CrossFit paper (Paper 3) complements them by diagnosing a different failure mode of self-evolving loops—'co-cheating' in proposer–solver agents—providing a useful contrast on how self-improvement can fail and be remediated across modalities.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读第二篇论文 RIDE（基于强化学习诱导方向的表征外推），该文理论最为扎实——将表征级蒸馏、外推理论与语言模型头部的各向异性机制分析紧密结合，且实验设计严谨、控制充分。第二篇读完后再读第一篇 UniEvo-VL：两篇都围绕"同策略自蒸馏"这一核心范式，但第一篇将该思想从文本推理拓展到基于流匹配的图像生成，通过引入"带批评信息的特权提示"实现自改进。最后阅读第三篇 CrossFit，它诊断的是自演化系统的另一类失效模式——提议器-求解器智能体中的"协同作弊"，可在不同模态上与前两篇互补，帮助理解自改进机制在何种条件下会失败及如何修复。
